status: protocol_frozen; one model-only candidate registered and locally validated, no scored eligible candidate yet

protocol.policy: model candidates only; no information probes; no LB-derived coefficients

selection_policy.cohort: No candidate is grandfathered. Register each mechanism-based card, immutable artifact hash, and passing-invariant result before its first score. Historical calibration candidates and probes are excluded.
selection_policy.candidate_A: Lowest successful public RMSE among eligible frozen-cohort model candidates; scores within the pairwise sampling guard are tied and use the predeclared simplicity/adjustment-count/candidate-ID tie-break.
selection_policy.candidate_B: Deterministic 50% shrink of A's composite predictions toward A's own provided-feature prediction mean within each official region; no target means, leaderboard results, or cell adjustments.
selection_policy.predicted_vs_actual_threshold: The former 1e-3 target-error rule is superseded: target labels are unavailable and probing is forbidden; local correctness/reproducibility invariants are required instead.

noise_estimate.per_cell_formula: SE_cell(MSE) approximately sd_cell/sqrt(0.30*n_cell); sd_cell is the standard deviation of per-tract squared-error contributions and is not observable without labels
noise_estimate.planning_assumption: independent approximately normal residuals; SE(RMSE) approximately RMSE/sqrt(2*n)
noise_estimate.historical_scale_candidate_note: P4 is an LB-calibrated historical benchmark used only to illustrate score sampling noise; it is not eligible for this protocol or a new model parameter
noise_estimate.pairwise_guard_rule: SE_public(candidate_1)+SE_public(candidate_2); a smaller public RMSE difference is a tie, not a selection reason

dates_with_upload_budget.purpose: two final candidate uploads by 12:00Z; reserved

candidate_registrations.hypothesis: The v0 detail failed because its component levels were uncentred proxies whose uncentred correlation with the target was 0.1786 and whose region-mean-removed detail was anti-informative (unconstrained beta -0.218). v2 replaces each proxy with a mechanism estimated from the provided Overture counts themselves - route/named-road ratio, fixed building residual prior calibrated against the Overture building presence rate, and the organiser's facility/establishments halves with fixed presence priors - so the composite should track the same completeness mechanism the organiser scored, giving centred correlation above the 0.30 forecast assumption and a public RMSE below the 0.091440198 P4 benchmark.

parameter_provenance.composite: mean of defined components (equal weights, undefined excluded)
parameter_provenance.transport: ratio of provided Overture route and named-road lengths (no prior)

candidate_registrations.prediction_basis: model-side moments of the frozen artifact (mu_v, sd_v, E[v^2]) with the all-zero candidate C0 platform RMSE as the E[y^2] anchor, assumed target mean equal to the model's own mean and assumed centred correlation 0.3; no LB-derived model parameter
candidate_registrations.reproduction_command: COMPETITION_WORKSPACE="$COMPETITION_WORKSPACE" /home/martin/hddProjects/langywrap/uv run --with numpy==2.5.4 --with pyarrow==26.0.0 --with pyproj==3.8.0 --with shapely==2.2.0 python scripts/build_estimator_v2_candidates.py --workspace "$COMPETITION_WORKSPACE"

template_only_rows.policy: uniform platform-only scalar 0.0 per b750a35; no eastern-WA features, regional-mean transfer, or target inference
